title: senecillis retusa
intro: Senecillis retusa, commonly known as Groundsel Tree or Buttercup Bush, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecillis retusa include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Senecillis retusa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
